description: This file defines the ChatController class, which manages chat sessions, handles messaging, event processing, session management, and communication with a backend gateway in a Kotlin-based Android application. It provides methods for sending messages, handling events like health checks and chat updates, managing session state, and parsing responses.

classes.name: MainSessionState
classes.description: A data class representing the current and applied main session key states in chat session management.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: A data class representing the chat history, including messages, session ID, and thinking level.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a single chat message with roles, content, timestamp, and ID.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Represents individual message content parts, such as text or attachments.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents information about individual chat sessions.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Represents an ongoing or pending tool call within the chat, tracking its ID, name, args, start time, and error state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific chat session by its session key.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets or updates the main session key used for conversation grouping.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a bootstrap process to refresh the chat state and health.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of available chat sessions.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the current thinking level for the chat, normalizing its value.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session based on session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message including attachments and thinking level to the chat session.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a message and awaiting server acceptance, updating UI state accordingly.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing chat runs.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Handles various streaming events from the gateway such as health updates, chat messages, and agent events.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the chat session, fetches history, and sets health status.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Fetches list of chat sessions from the server.

methods.name: pollHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Polls server health status if needed based on timing.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming chat events, updating chat messages and state accordingly.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Handles agent-related events such as assistant streaming text or tool calls.

methods.name: parseAssistantDeltaText
methods.description: Parses streaming assistant delta messages to extract text content.

methods.name: publishPendingToolCalls
methods.description: Updates the list of pending tool calls to observers.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for a pending run, to handle potential hang-ups.

methods.name: clearPendingRun
methods.description: Removes a pending run and cancels its timeout.

methods.name: clearPendingRuns
methods.description: Clears all pending runs and associated timeouts.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses chat history JSON from server into chat message objects.

methods.name: parseMessageContent
methods.description: Parses individual message content from JSON elements.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Parses session list JSON into session entries.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts run ID from server responses.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes thinking level strings to predefined values.
